reason: The README describes a full coding-agent harness whose primary purpose is coordinating coding tasks, subagents, workflows, terminal operations, project analysis, and plugin-based execution through TUI and Web interfaces.

summaries.zh: 天枢是一个基于插件组合的编码智能体运行框架，用于协调代码任务、子智能体、工作流、终端操作、项目检索与跨会话记忆。
summaries.en: Tianshu is a plugin-based coding-agent harness for coordinating code tasks, subagents, workflows, terminal operations, project retrieval, and cross-session memory.

capabilities: Runs coding-agent workflows with subagents and agent routing
Executes shell and PTY-based terminal operations
Reads and writes workspace files with snapshot-based rewind support
Uses Git capabilities and codebase indexing for retrieval and impact analysis
Connects to the DeepSeek API and optionally uses web access
Provides terminal and local web user interfaces
